in_marathi.name: Deepshika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Deep like the ocean, radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepshika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepshika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deep' which means deep like the ocean and 'Shikha' which means radiant.
